channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Nasdaq tumbles on AI spending concerns and jump in oil prices: Live updates
item.description: U.S. equities slid on Thursday, bogged down by declines in mega-cap names Meta Platforms and Tesla as worries around the artificial intelligence trade increase.

item.title: Musk's clash with Ukraine accelerates demand for Starlink alternatives. Few exist
item.description: Governments or companies looking for an alternative to SpaceX's Starlink are faced with few options, as Amazon, Eutelsat and others are far behind.

item.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey
item.description: Eight out of 10 Americans now rate the economy as fair or poor, one of several findings in a CNBC poll that show why Republican candidates face uphill battles.

item.title: Jobless claims near the lowest since the 1960s as low-fire trend continues
item.description: Initial filings for unemployment insurance slipped to a seasonally adjusted 194,000.

item.title: Third-party evaluators find vulnerabilities in OpenAI monitoring system during test pilot
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman pledged to grant independent evaluators "employee-like access" to the company to help address mounting safety concerns.

item.title: Why cybersecurity stocks are getting another big boost. They're key to the AI trade
item.description: Cyber stocks jumped Wednesday amid a rush of warnings from security agencies about threats to a widely used programming language.

item.title: Under-the-radar stocks to play the next leg of the energy trade with oil prices jumping again
item.description: Iran is going to grow more desperate as oil money dries up, which makes the country even more dangerous.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says neocloud demand is 'off the charts' but capital is scarce
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CNBC Thursday that demand for neocloud firms is "off the charts," but scarce capital is holding back growth.

item.title: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a Trump critic, charged in marijuana racketeering case

item.title: Cruise lines chase luxury travelers with suites for up to $25,000 a night

item.title: American Express brings Airbnb bookings and rewards to Amex Travel platform
item.description: More than 1 million Airbnb listings are now available to book through Amex Travel, allowing customers to earn membership points on prepaid bookings.

item.title: Blackstone's Jon Gray says CoreWeave can 'find a way through' financing pressure
item.description: Blackstone COO Jon Gray says CoreWeave's underlying business is strong despite concerns over its mounting debt.

item.title: American Airlines forecasts bigger loss in 2026 on fuel spike, plans to slow growth next year

item.title: Procter & Gamble earnings beat as sales rise 4%, boosted by laundry and home products
item.description: Procter & Gamble topped Wall Street's estimates for its quarterly earnings and revenue.

item.title: Spain accuses Trump ally Milei of ‘disgraceful’ election interference
item.description: Argentinia's Javier Milei launched a barrage of insults at Spain’s left-wing Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on a visit to Madrid, calling on voters to oust him.

item.title: David's Bridal plans to spin off AI platform Pearl into publicly traded company
